SimulatorInplaceVolumesResultRow.description:
Represents the columns of a row in a simulator inplace volumes export.

These fields are the current agreed upon standard result. Changes to the fields or
their validation should cause the version defined in the standard result schema to
increase the version number in a way that corresponds to the schema versioning
specification (i.e. they are a patch, minor, or major change).

ASSOCIATEDGAS.description: The associated gas volume of the fluid-type given in ``FLUID``. Optional.
ASSOCIATEDGAS.title: Associatedgas

ASSOCIATEDOIL.description: The associated oil volume of the fluid-type given in ``FLUID``. Optional.
ASSOCIATEDOIL.title: Associatedoil

DATE.description: Index column. The datetime this row represents. Required.
DATE.title: Date

FIPNUM.description: Index column. The fipnum region which this volume is coming from. Required.
FIPNUM.title: Fipnum

FLUID.description: Index column. The kind of fluid this row represents. Required.
FLUID.title: Fluid

GIIP.description: The GIIP volume of the fluid-type given in ``FLUID``. Optional.
GIIP.title: Giip

HCPV.description: The hydrocarbon pore volume of the fluid-type given in ``FLUID``. Optional.
HCPV.title: Hcpv

PORV.description: The pore volume of the fluid-type given in ``FLUID``. Optional.
PORV.title: Porv

STOIIP.description: The STOIIP volume of the fluid-type given in ``FLUID``. Optional.
STOIIP.title: Stoiip

SimulatorInplaceVolumesResultRow.title: SimulatorInplaceVolumesResultRow

description:
Represents the resultant simulator inplace volumes parquet file, which is
naturally a list of rows.

Consumers who retrieve this parquet file must read it into a json-dictionary
equivalent format to validate it against the schema.
title: SimulatorInplaceVolumesResult
